The '''Kessel revolts''' were a series of revolts that took place on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

==History==
The [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] revolts were instigated by [[Salis Kabor]], a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] revolutionary who dedicated his life to fighting [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].<ref name="Lorrd" />

During one of these revolts, [[Trioculus]], the [[Supreme Slavelord]] of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines of Kessel]], used a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] to annihilate thousands of protesting slaves.<ref name="QotE" />

==Aftermath==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], some [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of Kabor, the Kessel revolts were commemorated with a memorial in the [[Crypt of Martyrs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].<ref name="Lorrd" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Trioculus recounted the slave rebellion on Kessel to [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]].<ref name="QotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to [[Adrick Tolliver]], author of ''[[Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd]]'', the Kessel revolts are intended to be those referenced in ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', a [[1993]] book written by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|taloncard|12|Endnotes for "Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd"}}</ref>
